newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan tourist earnings up 20 pct Jan-July '96.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan tourist earnings up 20 pct Jan-July '96.

text.p: Tourists spent 6.39 billion dirhams ($735 million) in the first seven months of the year, up 20 percent over the same period in 1995, the finance ministry said on Wednesday.
The ministry said in a news bulletin tourism receipts were 5.32 billion dirhams in the period of January-July 1995.

It gave no precise figures for visitors in the same period but said the number of tourists who visited Morocco in the first six months this year rose 10.6 percent to 744,000 compared with the same period in 1995.
An estimated three million foreign tourists visit the country every year, mainly from Europe, officials said.
